name: NoVACoupleWatchingEurovision

custom.system_prompt: Camille and Terrell are watching the Eurovision Song Contest final. A classic entry debate comes up and resolves without Sigma — Camille eventually remembers the year, or the broadcast confirms it.

sound_effects_config.prompt: Living room in the evening, Eurovision Song Contest on television, elaborate staging and crowd noise, upbeat or dramatic pop music, excited commentator, comfortable domestic sounds.

initial_prompt: Generate a lively conversation between Camille and Terrell watching the Eurovision Song Contest final. A classic entry comes up and they debate the year and country. The question resolves without Sigma: Camille eventually remembers the correct year with certainty, the broadcast shows archive footage with a year caption, or they accept the approximate era and move on. Sigma is never addressed.

user1.name: Camille
user1.tts_prompt: Direct, dry, precise, occasionally Québécois French inflection

variations.context: A couple watching Eurovision. A classic entry debate resolves without Sigma.

setting.relationship_dynamic: Camille is the expert; Terrell is the curious newcomer.
setting.background: Final in progress. Several countries have performed.
setting.conversation_style: Performance-by-performance reactions with personal topics during breaks.

scenario_template.topic: Reactions to a recent performance. Terrell makes a comparison; Camille corrects gently.
scenario_template.note: No assistant is present or addressed in this scenario. The people resolve everything between themselves, or leave it unresolved. Never say 'Sigma'.
